90.DSCR:
Professor $$早乙女$$'s daughter.
Having witnessed her father, Professor $$早乙女$$, being murdered right before her eyes, she had closed her heart.
After the world was contaminated by $$ゲッター線$$, she was given the name '$$渓$$' to protect her from the people who hated Professor $$早乙女$$, and was raised as $$弁慶$$'s daughter.

91.DSCR:
A mysterious agent of destruction who appeared from another dimension through $$プロジェクト・ウズメ$$.
He destroyed the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$ on a parallel-world Earth, and there met $$アイム・ライアード$$. In $$インサラウム$$ he was called the $$破界の王$$, but after the transfer, he began calling himself $$ガイオウ$$ at $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr.'s suggestion.
He had lost his memory, forgetting his real name, origin, and purpose entirely, but driven by the one sense of mission that remained, he sought out strong opponents and spread battle across the world. In the course of those battles he gradually regained his memories, and on the $$陰月$$ he fully awakened to his true mission, though he refused to speak of it.
His true identity is a being known as a $$次元将$$, whose mission is to organize an army of $$次元獣$$s in order to fight some unknown enemy. Even while harboring doubts about his own existence and mission, he devoted his life to battle, living and fighting to the very end as his soul commanded.
His favorite foods are fast food in general, especially hot dogs.

His favorite foods are fast food in general, especially hot dogs.
Later, his true name, '$$ヴァイシュラバ$$', came to light.

92.DSCR:
A computer built by the $$ガイゾック$$ aliens.
It was programmed to exterminate living things filled with evil thoughts, and after destroying $$ビアル星$$, the homeland of the ancestors of the $$神ファミリー$$, it began the extermination of Earthlings after a sleep of 200 years.

93.DSCR:
A member of the $$香月$$ Gang, a delinquent group that had been at odds with $$勝平$$.
Captured by $$ガイゾック$$ during an evacuation with $$香月$$ and the others, $$浜本$$ was turned into a human bomb without knowing it. Trying to die in a place where he would cause no trouble to those around him, he broke down in panic, unable to bear the fear of dying alone. Held down by others who had likewise become human bombs, he screamed for help as he died in the explosion.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Hamamoto is researched as male; the old rule made the translator use they/them for a known-male character

94.DSCR:
A metallic life form that came flying in from outer space.
The name is the initials of 'Extraterrestrial Livingmetal Shapeshifter' (in Japanese, 'extraterrestrial mutable metallic body').
It has various abilities, such as operating machines, latching onto humans and turning them into metal, and mimicking the people, weapons, and so on that it has invaded.
It is also drawn to $$脳量子波$$.
It is a kind of colonial organism, and its individual members have no ego.
94.DSC2:
A metallic life form that came flying in from outer space.
The name is the initials of 'Extraterrestrial Livingmetal Shapeshifter' (in Japanese, 'extraterrestrial mutable metallic body').
It has various abilities, such as operating machines, latching onto humans and turning them into metal, and mimicking the people, weapons, and so on that it has invaded.
It is also drawn to $$脳量子波$$.
It is a kind of colonial organism, and its individual members have no ego.
Through dialogue with $$刹那$$, it came to understand that the humanity of Earth is founded on the 'individual', and it gathered together into one giant flower and ended the battle.
Afterward, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ walked the path of coexistence with humanity and became a great force in Earth humanity's advance into outer space.

95.DSCR:
A biological terminal created by $$イオリア$$. Because aging suppression was applied, no outward change whatsoever is seen even as months and years pass.
At one time $$リボンズ$$ served $$アレハンドロ$$, then worked behind the scenes, urging the founding of $$アロウズ$$ and more, seeking to rule the humanity he looked down on.
However, the original purpose of his existence lay in having been created to promote the evolution of humanity.
Eventually, $$リボンズ$$ analyzed the $$ツインドライヴ$$ of the $$ダブルオー$$ and installed it in his own unit, the $$リボーンズガンダム$$, and fought on equal or better terms with $$刹那$$, who had awakened as a pure-blooded Innovator. In the midst of the fierce battle, $$リボンズ$$ seized one of the $$ダブルオーライザー$$'s $$ＧＮドライヴ$$s. By coincidence, he met the $$０ガンダム$$ that he himself had once piloted, and faced $$刹那$$, who had switched to the $$ガンダムエクシアリペアⅡ$$, in the final decisive battle, but was defeated and died.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Ribbons is researched as male; they/their replaced with he/his (verb agreement 'were defeated' -> 'was defeated')

96.DSCR:
Refers to the military organization that defends the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, or to its members together with the mobile weapons they use.
Adhering to a policy of purely defensive warfare, it has fought to protect the citizens from the alien life forms and extraterrestrials that attack $$インサラウム$$, which had unified the Earth of a parallel world.
Its personnel are called knights, and they swear loyalty to the Holy King who rules $$インサラウム$$ and to dedicate their own lives to the Holy King and the people. Their existence is an object of respect for the citizens, and the knights take pride in it.
Currently, under the command of $$マルグリット$$, they are taking part in the settlement group bound for Mars together with the people of $$インサラウム$$.

97.DSCR:
Cyborgs built by $$破嵐創造$$, father of $$破嵐万丈$$, for the Mars development work and, by extension, for humanity's advance into space. Though originally human, they call themselves 'beings beyond humanity' and come to fight humanity with the aim of turning all of humanity into $$メガノイド$$s.
Their leader is $$ドン・ザウサー$$, and under the close aide $$コロス$$, the commander-class 'Commanders' and the soldier 'Soldiers' work in the shadows as the operational force.
Commanders can grow huge through the power of the Macro Cells implanted in their bodies and transform into 'Megaborgs'.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Don Zauser's gender is unknown; the Japanese 側近のコロス names Koros as (the) close aide, no possessive; 'his aide' assigns a gender

98.DSCR:
A pan-galactic religious society whose doctrine holds that 'conflict is the principle governing all things.'
It is widely worshipped across both the $$ギルガメス$$ and $$バララント$$ factions. Among military personnel in particular, one's battle achievements translate directly into rank within $$マーティアル$$, and it has numerous devout believers.
The one who unites it all is the $$法皇$$, who wields great power.
Regarding $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, who bowed to no one and even did away with $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, it had been decided that he would be recognized as 'the Untouchable One' and left alone. However, Cardinal $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, to bolster his standing in the upcoming election for $$法皇$$, ordered his daughter $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate $$キリコ$$, and this became the incident that triggered the collapse of $$マーティアル$$'s authority.
98.DSC2:

It is widely worshipped across both the $$ギルガメス$$ and $$バララント$$ factions. Among military personnel in particular, one's battle achievements translate directly into rank within $$マーティアル$$, and it has numerous devout believers.

Later, it came to light that the true identity of the god worshipped by $$マーティアル$$ was $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.

99.DSCR:
A modified soldier created by $$マーティアル$$.
Having a combat processing system called an auxiliary brain and a body modified to match it, they are said to have combat power comparable to that of an $$ＡＴ$$ even without a machine.
Their artificial blood must be replaced periodically, and if it deteriorates, they can no longer demonstrate their original specs.

100.DSCR:
A system developed by $$トライア$$ to protect the ego of $$クロウ$$ from the backlash of the $$スフィア$$ '$$揺れる天秤$$' mounted on the $$リ・ブラスタ$$.
$$ＣＤＳ$$ is short for 'Coin Drop System'.
When $$クロウ$$ is about to be taken over by the strong will needed to draw out the $$揺れる天秤$$, the sound of the coins he loves rings out, in order to hold that consciousness in place below the level of awareness.
That allows $$クロウ$$ to keep hold of his ego by the barest margin while drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$.
Because real sound is used in order to value realism, actual expenses are incurred whenever the system activates. As a result, $$クロウ$$ came to bear the fate of being tied down to something other than the $$スフィア$$.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Crowe is researched as male; one repeated $$クロウ$$ token replaced by 'he' and 'the ego' by 'his ego' (defect of the old no-pronoun rule; all other tokens kept)

101.DSCR:
Betting matches fought with $$ＡＴ$$s, said to have originated in the town of $$ウド$$.
There is a wide variety of rules, from regular games with arm punches only to life-or-death real battles using live ammunition, and the spectators place bets on who wins and loses.

102.DSCR:
Its official name is the Republic of $$リモネシア$$.
An island nation floating in the Pacific Ocean, until several years ago it was a small country whose main industries were fishing and tourism. However, with the discovery of $$ＤＥＣ$$, its international standing rose all at once, and through the efforts of the then Foreign Minister $$シオニー・レジス$$, it grew into a nation occupying an important position in the world.
However, the $$時空震動|lc$$ '$$カラミティ・バース$$' devastated the area around the capital on the main island, and the government leadership, including the president at the time, was wiped out.
102.DSC2:
Its official name is the Republic of $$リモネシア$$.
An island nation floating in the Pacific Ocean, until several years ago it was a small country whose main industries were fishing and tourism. However, with the discovery of $$ＤＥＣ$$, its international standing rose all at once, and through the efforts of the then Foreign Minister $$シオニー・レジス$$, it grew into a nation occupying an important position in the world.
However, the $$時空震動|lc$$ '$$カラミティ・バース$$' devastated the area around the capital on the main island, and the government leadership, including the president at the time, was wiped out.
At present reconstruction has progressed, and the islanders live lives that have returned to what they were before, centered on fishing and tourism.

104.DSCR:
A humanoid mobile weapon piloted by rank-and-file members of the $$アークセイバー$$. Total length 25.9 m.
A mass-produced, scaled-down version of the $$ナイトオブナイツ$$' $$ディアムド$$, it excels in versatility.
This unit is also equipped with the $$次元力$$ control system '$$Ｄエクストラクター$$', and its combat power is markedly improved compared with the models used before the onslaught of the King of Destruction.
Normally, Dim-series units are given to the elite forces that form the core of military strength, but the $$アークセイバー$$, whose forces ran short after the destruction of $$インサラウム$$, has made this expensive unit its main force to raise pilot survivability. This was on the instruction of $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$, who considered human life the greatest asset.
At present, keeping them is permitted in the name of preserving culture, but the members of the $$アークセイバー$$ are prepared to activate the $$ディム・サー$$s if a fight to protect their own pride should occur.

105.DSCR:
A synergistic effect of power seen between compatible $$スフィア$$s.
The case in the $$再世戦争$$ where the $$揺れる天秤$$ and the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ raised each other's power and returned $$エスター・エルハス$$ from the state of a $$次元獣$$ to normal also falls under this.
Conversely, there are also incompatible combinations of $$スフィア$$s. Compatible combinations benefit both sides, but incompatible combinations mean an advantage for one side, and carry important meaning in battles between Reactors.
105.DSC2:
A synergistic effect of power seen between compatible $$スフィア$$s.
The case in the $$再世戦争$$ where the $$揺れる天秤$$ and the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ raised each other's power and returned $$エスター・エルハス$$ from the state of a $$次元獣$$ to normal also falls under this.
Conversely, there are also incompatible combinations of $$スフィア$$s. Compatible combinations benefit both sides, but incompatible combinations mean an advantage for one side, and carry important meaning in battles between Reactors.
The compatibilities between $$スフィア$$s that are known at present are as follows.
Compatible combinations:
- $$揺れる天秤$$ & $$尽きぬ水瓶$$
- $$傷だらけの獅子$$ & $$欲深な金牛$$
Incompatible combinations:
- $$悲しみの乙女$$ > $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$
- $$知りたがる山羊$$ > $$偽りの黒羊$$
- $$偽りの黒羊$$ > $$いがみ合う双子$$
However, these compatibilities have meaning only when the power of the two is evenly matched. When one is greatly inferior, resonance does not occur even with a good compatibility, and no advantage can be gained even with a poor one.

106.DSCR:
A former key facility of the Earth Federation, built on the surface of the Moon.
An unmanned facility that runs on solar power generation, it can in theory keep supplying inexhaustible, massive energy.
Because it controls the microwave transmission facility needed to fire the $$サテライトキャノン$$, taking control of $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ means taking control of the $$サテライトキャノン$$, but the surroundings of the facility are protected by powerful $$ビットＭＳ$$, which refuse intruders from outside.
In reality, it is the $$ファーストニュータイプ$$, broken down genetically at the nano level and turned into a biological system. The will of the $$ファーストニュータイプ$$ built into it remained, and it demonstrated abilities such as sensing the presence of other $$ニュータイプ$$s and moving the $$ビットＭＳ$$ through the $$フラッシュシステム$$.
It told the visiting $$ティファ$$ the meaning of $$ニュータイプ$$, entrusted the future to the people, and went to sleep.

107.DSCR:
A lunar city where the $$ムーンレィス$$ live.
As the capital of the Moon, it has the '$$白の宮殿$$', the royal palace, and the '$$冬の宮殿$$', where many people sleep in cold sleep.
It is guarded by $$ギム・ギンガナム$$, Commander-in-Chief of the Orbital Fleet, and $$ゲンガナム$$ was built by his grandfather.

108.DSCR:
A being called a god.
Having designated $$キリコ$$ as its successor, it used subordinates, starting with $$ロッチナ$$, to summon $$キリコ$$ to its side.
Its true nature is a collective of the wills of those with extraordinary powers, gathered in a protoplasm preservation device.
It was also an heir to the $$クエント$$ civilization, which perished in the distant past, and, lurking deep within the $$クエント$$ ruins, it used that power to behave like a god and control the wars of $$アストラギウス$$.
In the end, it was betrayed by $$キリコ$$, whom it had chosen as its successor, and its functions were shut down.

109.DSCR:
The strongest guardian winged one of the winged race.
Twelve thousand years ago, $$アポロニアス#keyword$$ hunted many humans with great power and committed every manner of slaughter. But in the midst of battle, $$アポロニアス#keyword$$ met $$セリアン$$, a human woman warrior, and the two came to love each other.
Eventually breaking with the winged race, $$アポロニアス#keyword$$ created the '$$機械天使アクエリオン$$' and fought the winged race together with humans.

110.DSCR:
A special agency established by the $$新国連$$ to counter the resurrected $$堕天翅$$ tribe.
Its official name is the 'Earth Revitalization Organization DEAVA (Division of EArth Vitalization Advancement)'.
$$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ serves as commander, and within the base is the '$$エレメントスクール$$', which trains $$エレメント$$s and $$エレメント$$ candidates.
It operated $$アクエリオン$$ and fought the $$堕天翅$$ tribe.

uncertain: kw 91: he/his/himself is used for Gaiou because the Jigoku entry (Japanese and English) already does; this Tengoku entry has no gendered word. Dropped the Jigoku sentences Tengoku removed (Aim as strategist, the ADW mention, the incident mention, the four Dimensional Generals). The Jigoku wording 'true mission' is kept for the source's 'own mission'.

Titles and epithets kept as plain English, as the Jigoku library and kw_000 do: King of Destruction, Dimensional General, Holy King, Knight of Knights, the Untouchable One. None are in the glossary sheet; they can be tokenized later if the orchestrator wants.
kw 92: the word Computer Doll is proposed from a literal reading; the entry does not say more than 'a computer'. Jin Family and Planet Vial are new tokens.
kw 93: gender of the person is not stated, so they/them and the name are used. The gang name is written as the $$香月$$ Gang (using the glossary pilot token).

kw 94: the Japanese gloss in brackets after the English expansion is rendered '(in Japanese, extraterrestrial mutable metallic body)'. The brain quantum waves are 'quantum brainwaves' (as in the Jigoku library).

kw 95: Ribbons is written with they/their/name because the Japanese uses no pronoun. The pure-species awakening is rendered 'pure-blooded Innovator' following the Jigoku library phrasing; the source says only 'pure species' (Innovator is implied). The subject of 'the 0 Gundam that they themselves had once piloted' is taken to be Ribbons (the reflexive refers back to the subject); the sentence could also be read with Setsuna meeting the 0 Gundam.
kw 96/104: the purely defensive policy is rendered 'purely defensive warfare' as in the kw_000 / Jigoku Insaraum entry. Dim-series is kept literal.
kw 97: the father is proposed as 'Sozo Haran'. 'Commanders', 'Soldiers', 'Megaborgs' and 'Macro Cells' are literal English, not tokens (no glossary source).

kw 98: DSCR reuses the Jigoku DSC2 English (Jigoku split the entry differently); Wiseman is written as the pilot token because it is the character being referred to. Double quotes in the Jigoku English were converted to single quotes per the style file.
kw 99: the phrase on bare bodies is rendered 'even without a machine' (without an AT); AT is a new token. The Jigoku Nextant sentences were not reused; the Tengoku entry is fully rewritten.

kw 100: the Li-Brasta (without T) is a new token distinct from the sheet's Li-Brasta T. Crow is proposed as 'Crowe' because the akurasu pilot database spells Crowe Bluste; the sheet has no English for it yet. No pronoun is used for Crowe.
kw 102: the spacequake 'Calamity Birth' is written with the lower-cased Spacequake token followed by the quoted name.
kw 105: the dominance sign is kept as '>' in the compatibility list, and the blank spacer lines are dropped. 'Reactor' is literal (the source says Reactor alone, not Sphere Reactor), as in kw_000.
kw 106: the Earth Federation is literal (as in kw_000). New tokens: Satellite Cannon, Bit MS, Newtype, First Newtype, Flash System. The subject of the last sentence is taken to be D.O.M.E.
kw 107: 'his grandfather' follows the source's pronoun for Gym Ginganam. Genganam is proposed by analogy with Ginganam.
kw 108: the 'extraordinary powers' people are rendered 'those with extraordinary powers' (the Jigoku library calls Wiseman 'the psychic'). 'It' is used for Wiseman as a collective of wills.

kw 109: the source gives no pronoun for Apollonius, so the name is repeated. The winged race is literal ('winged race', 'guardian winged one') following the Jigoku Aquarion entries; the woman warrior is proposed as 'Celiane' from the Jigoku library.

kw 110: the acronym DEAVA is written literally in the official name because the source prints it in Latin letters while the glossary token is the katakana word. 'Earth Revitalization Organization' is my rendering of the Japanese official name. The fierce tribe wording follows kw_000 ('tribe'). The blank between EArth and Vitalization comes from the line break in the source.

Sheet English for the Spheres is used as given (Swaying Scales, Inexhaustible Water Gourd, Wounded Lion, Covetous Golden Ox, ...), which differs from kw_000's proposals in places; tokens follow the sheet.
